characterInteraction.description: Saffron directly addresses the viewer, making eye contact and using inclusive language.

scenes.contextualRelevance: By starting her message in Maori, Saffron implies respect for indigenous culture and a commitment to inclusivity. The juxtaposition of the smiling children in the poster with the harsh reality of child poverty emphasizes the need for change.

mood.description: Proud transitioning to Concerned and ending with Hopeful.

keyMoments.changeDescription: Facial expression shifts to a more serious one when discussing child poverty.

narrativeProgression.description: Saffron introduces herself and her candidacy
She outlines her passion for a clean, green economy
She highlights the issue of child poverty in New Zealand
She presents the Green Party’s vision for a wealthy nation
She concludes with a call to action for viewers to vote Green
